style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern school group meeting. A student leader stands straight, speaks with a firm unwavering expression and a crisp decisive downward open-hand gesture, while clearly pointing with the other hand to ONE chosen detailed drawing of a sturdy wooden bridge model on the table. Two classmates listen and nod, gathering the exact wooden parts for that choice. A second rejected flimsy paper-bridge drawing is set aside. Scene emphasizes speaking and deciding firmly with no hesitation, no changing mind, no anger, no shouting, no bullying. Mouth visibly speaking, eyes steady, confident direct posture. Drawings contain only diagrams, no words numbers letters. Realistic fingers wrists contact, table stable, wooden materials neatly grounded. Original school children, landscape 3:2, graphite watercolor colored pencil on ivory paper; no readable text logos brands or watermarks.
alt: 小組長站直身體，神情堅定地說話並指向選定的木橋模型，另一手俐落伸出，同學點頭準備材料。
